Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human lysosomal acid glucosylceramidase (CHEMBL2179). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target ChEMBL ID. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as compound_chembl_id. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
